description: Poll a public posterly signup session created by start_signup. Use this to narrate the free trial (card saved, nothing charged today), password setup, and agent access status before a posterly API key is installed. An account that already had a trial is charged at checkout instead. Keep updates user-facing; do not narrate raw HTTP, curl, or API plumbing.

debug.description: When true, include the raw signup session JSON for debugging. Keep false for normal user-facing agent flows.

session_id.description: Signup session ID returned by start_signup, usually the Stripe checkout session ID.

name: get_signup_session
